hooks.name: mob_effect_applicable
hooks.neoforge: MobEffectEvent.Applicable (result: ALLOW forces, DENY refuses, DEFAULT defers to the vanilla tag check)
hooks.doc: NeoForge's `MobEffectEvent.Applicable`, vanilla's `LivingEntity.canBeAffected`: asked wherever the game checks whether the effect `effect` (`minecraft:poison`) can land on the living entity `entity` (a [`LivingRef`], the player's own included), before `addEffect` accepts it. Unlike the effect hooks above this fires for every effect, vanilla's included, and only when an add is in flight. The first mod to answer decides: `Allow` or `Deny` overrides the vanilla tag check; an unanswered hook falls back to it. Server-side.

hooks.name: mob_effect_expired
hooks.doc: NeoForge's `MobEffectEvent.Expired`, vanilla `LivingEntity.tickEffects`: the effect `effect` (`minecraft:speed`, amplifier `amplifier`) on the living entity `entity` (a [`LivingRef`], the player's own included) counted down to nothing and is about to leave. Cancel and the effect stays, kept at no ticks and asked again next tick; unanswered, the expiry runs. Fires only on the tick an effect actually expires, never per tick. Server-side.

hooks.name: mob_effect_remove
hooks.doc: NeoForge's `MobEffectEvent.Remove`, vanilla `LivingEntity.removeEffect`: the effect `effect` (`minecraft:speed`, amplifier `amplifier`) on the living entity `entity` (a [`LivingRef`], the player's own included) is about to be removed by any path that walks the vanilla funnel: a command or milk for the player, a cure for a zombie villager, a mod's removal helper. Cancel and the effect stays. Server-side.
